story-context.title: AI Context Uplift & Benchmark Baseline
story-context.overview: Upgrade the AI instruction bundle (Context Pack) to v2 aligned with the real builder surface post-Stories 6.2.1/6.2.2; harden form_ai loading/config for testability; add a deterministic pytest harness over all 10 prompts in STORY-6.2-BENCHMARK-FORMS.md; record results in STORY-6.3-BENCHMARK-BASELINE.md.

dependencies.story: POC loop, validator integration, context pack v1 path
file-upload full stack; attachment UUID rules

constraints.item: Do NOT run Alembic upgrade/downgrade in agent shell unless Anthony explicitly asks; this story expects no new migrations.
Do not commit secrets or real LLM responses containing PII.
Benchmark harness must pass in CI with mocked LLM — no API key dependency.
Preserve single-page generation product rule unless Epic scope changes.

path.note: _load_context_pack(), CONTEXT_PACK_PATH, generate_form_definition(), prompt assembly, post-processing (normalize props, spacing).

Align context pack prop names and allowed types with this inventory.
